newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania barley harvest almost over, wheat starts.
newsitem.headline: Romania barley harvest almost over, wheat starts.

text.p: Romania has completed harvesting its 1997 barley crop on 83 percent of the land and is on course for a forecast output of 1.36 million tonnes, the agriculture ministry said on Thursday.
The ministry's Secretary of State, Aurel Pana, said the barley harvest so far amounted to some 1.22 million tonnes, with a yield of 3,500 kg per hectare. The total area under barley is 419,364 ha.
He said about three percent of Romania's 2.39 million hectares under wheat had also been harvested, yielding an average 3,100 kg per hectare, higher than forecasts of 2,900 kg.
Romania expects a bumper 1997 wheat crop of 7.07 million tonnes, more than double last year's figure of 3.1 million tonnes. It hopes to export 2.4 million tonnes.

Pana said the barley harvest would be complete within days, but offered no estimate on when wheat harvesting was expected to end. The figures were collected on July 7. --Diana Voicu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
